review_categories.analysis: Reviewed AgentAdapter.wrap/admit/aadmit: wrap constructs before/after analysis hooks; admission runs within the compile-placed trusted model coordinator. Runtime analysis callbacks are trusted configured code, not isolated worker code. This review does not prove their arbitrary effects are confined.
review_categories.model: Reviewed trusted model-selection/invocation path inside the agent or structured-response ModelInvocation node. MediatedNode authorizes dispatch, MODEL_READ and model_invoke before calling the coordinator in sync and async paths. The configured model/prompt implementations remain trusted; this is not a proof of arbitrary callback confinement.
review_categories.data: Reviewed coordinator construction/selection of exception or message data at this exact site. It does not release a tool or execute a worker. Model/branch placement still applies; arbitrary user-defined object methods are outside this local source-review claim.
review_categories.node: Reviewed both tool-enabled and tool-free graph construction: this RunnableCallable is marked as a trusted model coordinator, and each return passes security to StateGraph.compile. place_graph replaces it with MediatedNode before execution. This is source review plus placement regression evidence, not a complete mediation proof.
review_categories.hook: Reviewed registration of the caller-supplied hook: no hook executes at registration. StateGraph.compile passes security into place_graph, which classifies unresolved callbacks as untrusted and requires an UntrustedNodeHost unless explicitly promoted. The host isolation composition obligation remains open.
review_categories.send: Reviewed construction of Send/ToolCallWithContext data only. MediatedBranch routes resulting sends through dispatch authorization before the scheduler releases children; tests cover denied sync/async sends. This local review does not close all scheduler publication obligations.
review_categories.branch: Reviewed branch registration: the returned compiled graph wraps conditional paths with MediatedBranch. The local branch only selects destinations or constructs sends; send dispatch is checked before child release. This source review does not establish system-wide path coverage.
